about: Through real clippy on a planted crate: a production call to a disallowed method that no #[expect(clippy::disallowed_methods)] owns is refused, however the lint was switched off: #[allow(clippy::all)], an inner #![allow] of the lint, or allow(warnings) (the force-warn run sees through each); a call in an out-of-line #[cfg(test)] module is no site (canopi-f47t.52.240)

files.clippy.toml:
disallowed-methods = [
  { path = "std::thread::spawn", reason = "planted" },
  { path = "std::thread::scope", reason = "planted" },
  { path = "std::thread::Builder::spawn", reason = "planted" },
]
